name: language-rooting-docs
body:
The FQN convention is updated everywhere it is stated, because the observable FQN of every module and symbol changes: the AGENTS.md FQN table (its `module | fqn verbatim` row becomes the language-rooted form), README's FQN paragraph, SPEC §4 / the FQN-rule statements, and any suite-tool or agent-prompt example that shows a module or code FQN. Every documented example carries the language root; no doc or tool example shows a bare module/symbol FQN. The version/compatibility surface notes that the FQN rule change is an observable schema change (a major-version surface item per SPEC-1.0.0).

Acceptance: the AGENTS.md table documents `module = <language-id>.<module-identity>` and the symbol rows as inheriting it; README's FQN examples are rooted; no suite-tool description or example uses an unrooted module/code FQN; a reader of the docs cannot form the expectation of a bare module FQN.
